what: Photo and product strips flow endlessly and speed up with scrolling by that amount — a multiplier (1–4.5x) adding per-frame travel px × .15, rising over .3s, then after .1s returning to 1x over .8s power2.out. Scrolling down flows in the normal direction, scrolling up flows in reverse. With pause: glide, the strip slides to a stop over 1.2s power2.out while the interaction is held and flows again over 1.2s on release, and with drag: on it can be dragged and thrown (flows again after inertia). Rests when more than 300px off screen

options.lap: Seconds to pass one set — if given, used instead of speed (people strip 82·66 in the original)
options.speed: Distance covered per second with no lap (% of screen width), default 5 — the original product strip is screen width/20 px/s
options.dir: If right, it flows to the right (default left). Scrolling up reverses this
options.gain: Value multiplied by one Frame’s scroll px and added to the speed, default .15
options.pause: If glide, it glides to a stop over 1.2s once the hand is lifted (touch devices do not stop)
options.drag: If on, drag and throw — Draggable (with inertia if InertiaPlugin is present)
options.[data-fx-part=track·set]: One set inside the moving track — the set is cloned once
options.mode: With add, it adds instead of multiplying — to the default base px/s it adds scroll speed (px/s) × gain up to max and follows with rise and fall (direction doesn’t change, no drag or stop options)
options.base: Default speed of mode: add in px/s, default 42
options.rise · fall: mode: add — follow rate per 60fps frame when speeding up · slowing down, default .24 · .055 (gain default .11, max default 320 px/s)

use: Photo cell…

from.where: index.html .dc-packs (product band below the hero — speed 5 · pause: glide · drag: on, original ProductsCarouselInfinite: one set R/2 runs in R×25/(screen width×2.5) seconds, and on hover timeScale goes to 0 in 1.2s power2.out) · two .dc-strip people bands (original DDD: top 82s leftward, bottom 66s rightward)
index.html testimonial strip .hl-marquee — lap 46 · gain .12 · max 7 (the original is a speed multiplier chasing scroll px × .12 at .08 per step, adding at most 6)
index.html Hero large marquee · thin marquee below the letter — mode: add; base: 42; gain: .11; max: 320; rise: .24; fall: .055 (original Marquee: 42px per second + min(320, scroll px/s × .11))

note: A strip that only changes direction without speeding up is scroll-dir-marquee, and a strip that flows by itself and only responds to dragging is drag-marquee. The original uses Lenis velocity (px per frame) while the part uses ScrollTrigger velocity ÷ 60.
